caption: The drawing is a monochromatic pencil illustration depicting a single object that appears to be a detailed, ornamental glass vessel. The object lies horizontally across the center of the page, oriented with a cylindrical neck to the right and two rounded, tubular openings to the left. The main body of the vessel is bulbous and highly decorated with three prominent, wavy bands running parallel along its length, each adorned with intricate ruffled and curled designs. The neck of the vessel is long and straight, ending in a narrow mouth with two circular rings near the tip. The entire drawing is rendered in shades of grey with careful shading to indicate depth and the reflective quality of glass. The background is plain and uncolored, and there is a small scale in the bottom left corner and a rectangular signature at the bottom right corner reading “HUMARALLI.”
title: Bellows Bottle
